nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group, $q$ a natural number and $g \in G$. For $x \in G$ and $c \in \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ write $x^c$ for $x^n$, where $n$ is the natural-number value of $c$: its representative in $\{0, \dots, q-1\}$ when $q > 0$, and $|c|$ when $q = 0$ (in which case $\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z} = \mathbb{Z}$). Then $(g^b)^a = (g^a)^b$ for all $a, b \in \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Correctness of Diffie–Hellman key agreement

nodes.title: Value of the Diffie–Hellman shared key

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group of order $q$, with $q \neq 0$, and let $g \in G$ generate $G$, that is, every element of $G$ is an integer power of $g$. Then $a \mapsto g^a$ is a bijection from $\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ to $G$, where $g^a = g^n$ for the representative $n \in \{0, \dots, q-1\}$ of $a$. Its inverse is the discrete logarithm to base $g$.
nodes.title: Exponentiation from a generator is a bijection

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group, $q$ a natural number, $g \in G$ and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$. Then $g^a$ is defined as $g^n$, where $n$ is the natural-number value of $a$: its representative in $\{0, \dots, q-1\}$ when $q > 0$, and $|a|$ when $q = 0$ (in which case $\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z} = \mathbb{Z}$).

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
